events.did: 在 Turn Around 餐店的柜台后擦台面
events.quote_anchor: He stood, wiping the counter at the Turn Around, so-called more because the diner had been falling into disrepair when he first purchased it

events.did: 喊了声“爸爸”便径直走向角落卡座，放下包后弯腰挠 Dol 的耳朵
events.quote_anchor: “Hey, Dad!” she called out, beelining for the corner booth. She slung her bag onto the seat, and flopped down beside it, bending to scratch Dol’s ears.

events.did: 说在路上发现一只被车撞的猫，不能把它留在那里
events.quote_anchor: “Found a cat on the way over,” she said. “Must have been hit by a car. Couldn’t leave it there.”

events.did: 在互联网各处留暗哨以防 EON 复活，目前无人触发
events.quote_anchor: He kept feelers going in every corner of the internet, just to be safe. So far, no one had tripped them.

events.did: 认出 Daniela Dean 的名字曾出现在他给 Victor 编的化学家名单上
events.quote_anchor: Mitch caught on. And remembered where he’d seen the name before. It had been on a list of chemists he’d compiled. For Victor.
“Actually,” she said. “I was hoping I could spend the night.”

events.did: 把自己劈开，一个去给 Syd 开门，另一个去柴堆
events.quote_anchor: Mitch rolled his eyes, and then split himself apart, one version jogging to get the door for Syd while the other headed for the woodpile.

events.did: 把斧头砍在第一根木柴上，呼出冷气并笑了
events.quote_anchor: But as Mitch brought the axe down on the first log, and the sound rang through the trees, he sighed a cold breath into the air, and smiled.

relations.quote_anchor: “Hey, Dad!” she called out, beelining for the corner booth.

relations.did: 睡在角落卡座桌下，长后腿伸在桌外
relations.quote_anchor: Dol helped, his long rear legs stuck out from a corner booth, where he was sleeping beneath the table.

relations.did: 扬起的嘴角让 Mitch 想起 Victor
relations.quote_anchor: The corner of her mouth tipped up in a way that reminded him way too much of Victor.

relations.did: 在 Lockland University 上学，是那里的学生
relations.quote_anchor: She’d started at Lockland University last year after—well, after everything.

numbers.did: 分裂出更多自己：“四只手”胜过“两只手”，“八只手”胜过“四只手”
numbers.quote_anchor: It turned out, four hands were better than two, and eight were better than four, and so on.

numbers.did: 那天早上吃了“七根薯条”、一片吐司，外加一勺别人掉的冰淇淋
numbers.quote_anchor: This morning I saw him eat seven French fries and a piece of toast.

numbers.did: 数出 Mitch 眉间那“两道”竖纹
numbers.quote_anchor: pointing at the two vertical creases that had taken up residence between his brows

numbers.did: 一手（one hand）拿摩卡，另一手（the other）拿巧克力牛奶
numbers.quote_anchor: Mitch came over, a mocha in one hand and a chocolate milk in the other.

numbers.did: 每隔一个周末（every other weekend）开车跨州去看 Mitch
numbers.quote_anchor: didn’t look old enough to drive across state lines to visit every other weekend, either—but she was both.
It was hard to believe she was already a sophomore.
